shots.focal_element: Scrunch 'Create a new brand' web form in a full browser window, with the presenter's circular webcam bubble and the recorder's control bar pinned bottom-left
shots.transition_other: none: first shot, video opens directly on the recording (anchors give no transition)
shots.typography: Native product UI text only, captured at browser scale and very small in frame: lowercase wordmark, bold sentence-case form title and section headers, regular-weight sentence-case labels and grey placeholder/body copy, normal tracking; a geometric sans (low-confidence guess: Inter). No added captions or kinetic type.
shots.what_happens: Unedited single-take Loom-style screen recording with a talking-head webcam bubble. The presenter frames the feature as self-serve brand creation for agencies (w0-w21), pastes a website URL into the empty field (about w22-w30) and submits; a centred star-shaped loader then spins over a greyed form while sections fill in behind it (identity/description, then personas, then competitors) as he narrates what the platform generates (w102-w195). Around w196-w210 the loader clears and the page scrolls through the finished form: Personas list with descriptions, Competitors table (Netflix, Prime Video, Hulu, Max and more) and Key Topics chips, with a 'Create brand' button; the cursor hovers persona rows and 'Add Persona' as he says he can edit and add personas (w211-w219). Roughly 50 s of the first 70 s is the same static loading state with only the speaker's face changing. The remainder of the shot (after about 71.5 s, w220-w333, including clicking create brand, a pause and landing on the live Disney+ dashboard per the transcript) was not in my contact sheets.
shots.build_rebuild: Record the browser at full frame with a circular webcam overlay bottom-left, then rebuild as a recreated UI: type the URL into the input, cut the generation wait to a 1-2 s loader beat, and stagger-reveal the Personas, Competitors and Key Topics sections with a slow scroll synced to the matching voice-over phrases.
